bookCredit: Prince Caspian by C. S. Lewis (1951) is quoted only in short lines.
title: Before and After Aslan

banner.alt: A sunny river town: a bridge coming apart under climbing ivy, a schoolhouse with leaves at the windows, and a cottage with a bed in the open air

keepsake.name: golden apple
keepsake.line: Only Imagination Trip travelers earn this one. From the moles’ orchard at Cair Paravel.

postcard.kicker: Nell · a program for a holiday
body: While Peter fights Miraz, Aslan takes the girls on a holiday. Ivy pulls down a bridge. A schoolroom turns into a glade. A cottage lifts off a sick old woman.
Build three things before Aslan came, and after.
postcard.word: A ford is a shallow place where you can walk across a river.

mission.h: Build three befores and three afters
mission.p: Side by side, in pairs: bridge and ford, desk and rose bush, cottage and bed in the open air.

steps.build:
Open your menu (top button, right controller) and click Models. Build in this order:
  1. pair 1: a board for the bridge, the splashing ford beside it
  2. pair 2: Miss Prizzle’s desk, the rose bush it became
  3. pair 3: the cottage, the bed in the open air
steps.say: Stand between the befores and afters. Practice these 2 sentences:
steps.frame: “Before Aslan, the ___ was ___. After, it ___, which shows ___.”
steps.extra: Put the Lion (OptimaED) at the head of the row: Aslan, the girls on his back.

points: Your video is 30 seconds or less, shows all three pairs, and you say 2 sentences: one thing Aslan changed, before and after, and what it shows about his kind of victory, with a detail from Chapter 14.

alt.p: Aslan’s holiday moves from the hill to the battlefield. Tap the stops in order.
alt.gameH: Tap the next stop on the romp

events.t: The girls wake and ride on Aslan’s back
events.s: flutes, cymbals, Bacchus and his wild girls

events.t: The river god asks to be loosed
events.s: ivy climbs the piers and the Bridge of Beruna falls

events.t: The girls’ school becomes a glade
events.s: Miss Prizzle’s desk is a rose bush; Gwendolen stays
dogs break their chains, horses kick their carts to pieces

events.t: The cottage lifts off a sick old woman
events.s: colour comes back to her face; she asks for breakfast

events.t: The old woman runs to Caspian
events.s: on the field where Miraz’s army has laid down its swords: his old nurse

alt.miss: Not yet. Follow Aslan from the hill, down to the river, through the town, and out to the farms.

write.q: Pick one thing Aslan changed in Chapter 14: the bridge, the schoolroom, the chained dogs, the cottage, or the old woman. In 2 sentences, say what it was before and after, and what that shows about Aslan’s kind of victory.

scripts.brief: Hello, dear. It’s Nell. Chapter 14 tells two stories at once. While Peter fights Miraz in the lists, Aslan takes the girls on a holiday: ivy pulls down a bridge, a schoolroom turns into a forest glade, and a cottage lifts right off a sick old woman. Build three things as they were before Aslan came and as he left them, side by side, and tell me what one of them shows.
scripts.alt: No headset? Sit by my bench. Aslan’s holiday runs from the hill down to the river, through the town, past the farms, and out to the battlefield. Tap the stops in order, and you will see that his victory never needed a sword.
scripts.saved: Three befores, three afters, and the Lion at the head of the row. Here is your golden apple, the last of the unit. Keep it, and remember the old nurse running across the field to Caspian.

testPara: Before Aslan, the cottage was a tiny house with a dying old woman inside. After, it fell apart and she sat up well again, which shows his victory heals instead of hurting.
